concerns.text: FR-004 mandates Type I error estimation "by shuffling group labels multiple times with a fixed random seed" on the real datasets; T005/T007 implement the plan's simulated-null approach instead. The plan's methodological correction may be sound, but the spec was never amended — the task list silently relaxes a MUST requirement. Amend FR-004/US-2 to authorize the simulated-null design (or note the supersession in the spec), so the task list is not the only place the change is documented.

FR-001 requires datasets "from UCI Machine Learning Repository and OpenML"; T002 downloads exclusively via `fetch_openml` with no UCI sourcing. Either add UCI coverage or record a documented narrowing of FR-001 in the spec — as written, the task's deliverable falls short of the FR it tags.

T006's verification says "all 27 (3 d × 3 transform × 2 test... plus untransformed baseline) JSON files" — 3×3×2 = 18 (24 with baseline). The count 27 matches no arithmetic; the acceptance check is ambiguous and could pass/fail arbitrarily. State the exact expected file count and naming.

SC-004 requires bootstrap CI half-width ≤ ±0.02, but T006 generates only ≥1000 simulated datasets per effect size — insufficient for power near 0.5 (~2,400 iterations needed). Either raise the iteration floor or state explicitly how the SC-004 target is met (e.g., via aggregation across strata); as written the task can satisfy its own verification while failing the SC it must serve.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T002 vs spec.md:Edge Cases (checkpointing), plan.md:Complexity Tracking
concerns.text: The spec's checkpointing edge case ("checkpoint progress after each dataset") and the plan's justification (network interruption during download) apply to the download step, but T002's download has no checkpoint/resumption requirement — only T007 (per-stratum) uses checkpointing. Add per-dataset checkpointing to T002 or document why it is scoped out.

Two schema-conformance gaps: (a) T003 records datasets with >10% missingness in datasets.csv as filtered_out, but the schema caps missing_pct at 10 — those rows cannot conform; (b) T003 excludes "no continuous variable" datasets but filter_reason's enum has no matching value. Fix the schema or the recording flow so excluded rows are validly encodable.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T005/T006/T007/T009 output paths vs plan.md:Project Structure
concerns.text: Plan/data-model specify flat result files (results/type1_error_results.csv, power_results.csv, sensitivity_results.csv) but tasks write to results/type1_error/[stratum].json, results/power/*.json, results/aggregated/sensitivity_analysis.json, data/results/type1_error_pilot.json. Pick one layout so T012's paper handoff and verifications trace to real files.

The spec's TestResult entity lists Mann-Whitney U as a test type, but the test_result schema enum and all tasks cover only t-test/ANOVA. Either add a task/schema support or remove the orphan option from the spec so the task list is not silently narrowing the entity definition.
